        ### Question

Physical examination revealed a loss of strength in the upper limbs with preserved sensitivity. Pulmonary auscultation shows generalized hypophisis. A chest x-ray is performed, showing uninspired lungs and laminar atelectasis in the lung bases. Gasometry shows pH 7.39, PCO2 48 mmHg, PO2 63 mmHg, HCO3 28 mmol / L, SatO2 93%.         ### Options

opb. Alteration of diffusion and disturbance of the ventilation / perfusion relationship.
opc. Alveolar hypoventilation and decrease in FiO2.
opd. Disorder of the ventilation / perfusion relationship and alveolar hypoventilation.
ope. Increased pulmonary artery pressure and decreased diffusion.
